Skoro svaki brzi punjač u Srbiji ima CCS: Almost every fast charger in Serbia has CCS2. CHAdeMO is rarer and is found mostly on chargers up to 75 kW.
Skoro uvek se isplati. Zamena brojila ko: It almost always pays off. Replacing the meter costs in the order of ⟦0⟧–⟦1⟧ RSD, and the difference between the day and night price is threefold. On a single-tariff meter, even night-time charging is billed at the full price.
Skupština grada usvojila je odluku o pos: The City Assembly has adopted a decision to install five chargers powered by solar panels.
The assembly sets a monthly amount per car. If the flat fee is lower than the actual consumption, everyone still pays the difference. It works as a temporary solution until a meter is installed.
Skupština retko odbija sam punjač, nego: The assembly rarely rejects the charger itself; what it rejects is unclear billing and unclear liability. Give the answers in writing, in the specification, before the meeting.
Skupština sme da postavi uslove: da inst: The assembly may set conditions: that the installation be removable, neatly routed and certified. It may not sell you electricity with a markup: electricity is reimbursed by the meter at the price on the bill. Anything beyond that is a matter for the building manager and a lawyer.
Skupštine odbijaju kad niko ne odgovori: Assemblies refuse when nobody answers two questions: who pays for the electricity and who is liable if something goes wrong. With the paperwork it is a different conversation: MID metering, a test certificate, a technical specification and a draft decision. The whole procedure is in the assembly guide.
